_doc: Skatepark art (story 5.4, AD-28), read by entities/Park.js and drawn by scenes/ParkArt.js with procedural canvases: concrete slabs, coping edges, ramp shading are code, everything placed is here. Per map id: `floor` is the tile rect the ground canvas covers (the plaza plus its gate posts), `slab` the slab size in px, `pieces` flat bodies that are only drawn (funbox, bowl; their launching ramps are map objects, so scripts/check-skatepark.mjs requires ramps beside every piece), `gates` the fence gaps that get posts (axis x = a gap in a horizontal fence), `decals` kid-safe graffiti drawn on the ground (kind word with `text`, or star, bolt, circle, triangle, blob; x, y in tiles, size px, rot rad). `signRadius` / `signLeave` px: a `sign` object shows its text as a toast when a player comes within signRadius and again after they went further than signLeave.
